items.reason: A 10% glycolic toner is a mild way to work on the look of uneven texture, and eight months after stopping isotretinoin is past the usual waiting window for a gentle product.
Glycolic acid makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 should go with it.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier and offsets dryness while you start an exfoliating toner.

response.routine_note: Start the toner at night just 2 nights a week, then build up slowly if your skin stays comfortable, and apply SPF every morning. If you are unsure about timing after isotretinoin, check with your prescriber or a dermatologist first, and stop the toner if you notice stinging or persistent irritation.
